title: French far-right candidate Le Pen vows to end Macron's pension reform if elected

contentText: Far-right French presidential contender Marine Le Pen said Tuesday she would eliminate President Emmanuel Macron's pension reform, allowing hundreds of thousands of French workers to retire earlier, and create a new €900 billion retirement fund. The frontrunner in polls to win the presidential race is seeking to convince investors she can balance one of her most popular pledges with promises ​to restore order to ‌the public finances.
